API (all require Bearer auth; errors are {error:{code,message,...}, requestId}).
1) GET /api/restore/templates -> {templates:[{id:"super-league-auction-2026", name, teamCount:8, playerCount:99, hostTeam:"Ritzz FC", snapshot:<RestoreSnapshot>}]}.
2) POST /api/restore/preview body {snapshot} (strict) -> {preview}. Rate limit 30/min; bodyLimit 256 KB.
3) POST /api/restore/rooms body {auctionName, hostTeamName?, snapshot, settings?} (strict; settings only playerTimerSeconds, antiSnipingEnabled, antiSnipingThresholdSeconds, antiSnipingResetSeconds, allowCustomBids, autoAdvance, transitionDelaySeconds, minimumParticipants) -> 201 {roomId, roomCode, settings, host:{userId,teamId}, team:<publicTeam of host team>, restore:{source:"TEMPLATE"|"CUSTOM", snapshotName, warnings:string[], teams:[{id,name,claimed}]}, remainingPool:{total,byPot}}. hostTeamName defaults to snapshot.hostTeam; unknown -> 422 HOST_TEAM_NOT_FOUND. Critical issues -> 422 RESTORE_VALIDATION_FAILED with error.issues (CRITICAL only) and error.preview. Rate limit 5/min. Server re-validates; client preview is never trusted. source is TEMPLATE only when the snapshot hash equals a shipped template.
4) POST /api/rooms/:code/join body {restoredTeamId:<uuid>} (teamName/teamLogoEmoji/teamLogoUrl optional and ignored) -> 200 {roomId, roomCode, team:<publicTeam>, sequence}. Without restoredTeamId in a restored room -> 400 RESTORED_TEAM_REQUIRED. Normal rooms keep the old strict body; restoredTeamId in a normal room -> 400 NOT_A_RESTORED_ROOM. Errors: 404 TEAM_NOT_FOUND, 409 TEAM_ALREADY_CLAIMED, 409 ALREADY_CLAIMED_ANOTHER_TEAM, 409 INVALID_STATE (not LOBBY). Same user + same team is idempotent (200).
5) GET /api/rooms/:code (any authenticated user) now adds, for restored rooms only, restore:{snapshotName, teams:[{id,name,claimed}]} (no budgets/rosters/user ids). Note settings.startingBudgetCr for a restored room is the highest restored purse (59 for the template), not a real opening balance; use restore/team data for purses.
6) POST /api/rooms/:code/restore/release body {teamId} (host only, LOBBY only) -> {teams:[{id,name,claimed}], sequence}. Errors: 403 HOST_REQUIRED, 400 NOT_A_RESTORED_ROOM, 409 HOST_CANNOT_LEAVE (own team), 409 TEAM_NOT_CLAIMED, 404 TEAM_NOT_FOUND. Emits MEMBER_LEFT + ROOM_UPDATED.
7) GET /api/rooms/:code/restore/pool?search&group(ALL|GK|CB|FB|CM|CDM|CMID|CAM|WM|ST|W)&offset&limit(<=100, default 50) (member only) -> {total (after search/group), offset, limit, poolTotal (eligible, unfiltered by search), byPot:{GK,CB,FB,MID,ATT:count}, ownedCount, players:[publicPlayer], sequence}. 403 NOT_ROOM_MEMBER, 400 NOT_A_RESTORED_ROOM.
8) POST /api/rooms/:code/leave in a restored room frees the claim (team, squad, purse stay). KICK_MEMBER WS/engine command (payload.targetTeamId) does the same. PATCH settings / UPDATE_SETTINGS: 409 RESTORE_SETTINGS_LOCKED for startingBudgetCr, maxSquadSize, numberOfTeams, playerPoolSource, retention; timers/anti-sniping etc. still editable; purses are never touched.
9) START_AUCTION command: 409 RESTORE_TEAMS_UNCLAIMED while any team has no manager. Existing bid errors apply: INSUFFICIENT_BUDGET (0 Cr team), SQUAD_FULL (20 players). No new WS commands/event types (ROOM_UPDATED, MEMBER_JOINED, MEMBER_LEFT reused).

SNAPSHOT SHAPE (RestoreSnapshot, strict): {version:1, name, hostTeam?, teams:[{name, squadSize, remainingPurseCr (0.5 steps), retainedCount, auctionCount?, verify?:string, players:[{name, position, acquisition:"RETENTION"|"AUCTION", underdog?:boolean, playerId?:string (host picks a catalog id), manual?:{ovr?:number} (create restored-only player, id manual-<sha1 12>), verify?:boolean}]}]}. 2..32 teams, <=40 players per team in the schema (squad > 20 is a CRITICAL preview issue, not a schema error). Host resolution is sent back embedded in the player entry (playerId or manual) and re-posted to preview/rooms.
PREVIEW SHAPE: preview:{name, teams:[{name, squadSize, actualPlayers, remainingSlots, remainingPurseCr, retainedCount, auctionCount, verify?, players:[{name, position, acquisition, underdog, verify, match:{kind:"MATCHED_FC26"|"MATCHED_DEFAULT_POOL"|"AMBIGUOUS"|"UNMATCHED"|"MANUAL"|"RESOLVED", playerId?, source?:"FC26"|"DEFAULT_POOL"|"MANUAL", matchedName?, fullName?, club?, ovr?, photoUrl?, positions?, candidates?:[CandidateSummary], suggestions?:[CandidateSummary]}, issues:[]}]}], issues:[{severity:"CRITICAL"|"WARNING", code, teamName?, playerName?, message}], totals:{teams,players,retained,auction,matchedFc26,matchedDefaultPool,manual,unresolved}, remainingPool:{total, byPot}, canConfirm}. CandidateSummary:{playerId,name,fullName?,position,positions,club?,ovr,underdog,photoUrl?,source}. Host resolution search (pre-creation): 10) GET /api/restore/players?search=<1..100 chars, required>&group=ALL|GK|CB|FB|CM|CDM|CMID|CAM|WM|ST|W&offset&limit(<=50, default 20) -> {total, offset, limit, players:[publicPlayer]} (rate limit 60/min). The host picks a player and the UI sets playerId on that snapshot entry (or sets manual:{ovr?} to create a restored-only player), then re-previews.
ISSUE CODES. CRITICAL: SQUAD_COUNT_MISMATCH, RETAINED_COUNT_MISMATCH, AUCTION_COUNT_MISMATCH, SQUAD_TOO_LARGE, DUPLICATE_PLAYER, DUPLICATE_TEAM_NAME, INVALID_POSITION, PLAYER_AMBIGUOUS, PLAYER_UNMATCHED, EMPTY_PLAYER_POOL. WARNING: TEAM_VERIFY (team casing note), VERIFY_ENTRY (V. Boniface), RETAINED_ABOVE_LIMIT, POSITION_MISMATCH, UNDERDOG_MISMATCH, MANUAL_PLAYER, DEFAULT_POOL_MATCH.
TEMPLATE RESULT: 8 teams, 99 players (11 retained, 88 auction), 16 UNDERDOG tags (the plan said 18; the brief lists 16 and the file matches the brief), 99/99 matched FC26 by exact short_name, 0 default-pool, 0 needing host resolution, canConfirm true, remainingPool.total = FC26 catalog total - 99. Warnings: TEAM_VERIFY for Dakshineswar FC capitalization and VERIFY_ENTRY for V. Boniface. All 16 underdogs are recognised as UNDERDOG by the catalog (no UNDERDOG_MISMATCH).

STATE SHAPES. GET /api/rooms/:code/state (roomState) adds: restore:null for normal rooms, else {enabled:true, source, snapshotName, restoredAt, warnings, unclaimedCount, teams:[{teamId,name,claimed,purseCr (current remaining),openingPurseCr,squadSize (current),remainingSlots (current),retainedCount,auctionCount}]}. Each teams[]/currentUserTeam entry (publicTeam) now has claimed:boolean, remainingSlots:number, userId:"" for unclaimed teams (sentinel never exposed), and for restored rooms restoredRetainedCount, restoredAuctionCount; existing fields unchanged (remainingBudgetCr is the exact restored purse at start). soldPlayers[] entries for restored players: {id, playerId, teamId, acquisitionType:"RETENTION"|"AUCTION", isRetained, priceCr:null, restoredFromSnapshot:true, recordedPriceCr: 15 for retained / null for auction, ...}; ordinary purchases unchanged. players[] includes the 99 restored players with status:"SOLD", restoredFromSnapshot:true, restoreSource. roomActivity excludes restored purchases. GET /api/rooms/:code/teams/:teamId players[] add restoredFromSnapshot + recordedPriceCr and acquisitionPriceCr:null for restored players. publicTeam(team, settings, retention?, restore?) has a 4th optional param.

DESIGN NOTES. Restored purchases carry priceUnits 0 so the ledger invariant (sum priceUnits == spentUnits) holds; team.startingBudgetUnits is the restored purse; assertRoom uses room.restore.teams[].purseUnits. Unclaimed team userId = "unclaimed:<teamId>"; START is blocked until all are claimed. Pot start: normal random pot order (no forced Attackers round 1). Archive: restored purchases archive with price = recordedPriceUnits ?? player base price (DB readCompletedAuction needs > 0). Restart: room persists via createFromBuilder -> repository.create; recover() hydrates and assertRoom passes (tested for Memory and File repositories). No migration needed. Not done / intentionally left: hub.ts teamPresence for the host still exposes the "unclaimed:<id>" sentinel in the (host-only) presence list; remaining-pool search is room-scoped only (no pre-creation global player search).
